lead.headline: NYSE and Blockchain.com partner to tokenize US equities for on-chain trading
lead.tldr: Traditional finance and crypto infrastructure are converging faster than regulation can keep up: the NYSE enters tokenized stocks while the SEC admits it dropped cases to preserve credibility, revealing a enforcement regime in tactical retreat just as institutional demand for on-chain assets accelerates.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: NYSE, Blockchain.com in tie-up to bring tokenized US stocks to crypto users
top_signals.summary: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Blockchain.com have entered a partnership to offer tokenized US stocks and market data to cryptocurrency users. This move aims to meet the increasing demand for on-chain equity trading.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The NYSE-Blockchain.com partnership signals that incumbent exchanges now view tokenized equities as customer-retention infrastructure rather than competitive threat, which reprices the entire RWA middleware stack toward distribution partnerships with established venues.

top_signals.title: Ex-SEC acting chair: Agency dropped crypto cases to avoid issues with credibility33m, Ex-SEC acting chair: Agency dropped crypto cases to avoid issues with credibilitySEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda said that the agency dropped many cases against crypto companies in early 2025 to avoid potential credibility problems in court.
top_signals.summary: SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda revealed that the agency dropped numerous crypto-related cases in early 2025. This decision was reportedly made to prevent potential credibility issues and losses in court.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Uyeda's admission that the SEC dropped cases to avoid courtroom losses reveals the agency's enforcement strategy was running on bluff, and its retreat removes a key overhang that had been priced into crypto valuations at a discount.

top_signals.title: Hut 8 wins bidding for Poolin’s Texas data centers with $140 million offer
top_signals.summary: Hut 8 has won the bidding process for Poolin's Texas-based data centers with a $140 million offer. This bid significantly outperformed the initial stalking horse offer of $52 million for the Pyote and Tarbush sites.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Hut 8's $140 million bid at 2.7x the stalking horse price for distressed mining infrastructure indicates institutional miners are underwriting Texas energy assets on data-center conversion potential, not Bitcoin mining economics alone.

top_signals.title: Zcash hits record high of $1,600 as token’s privacy narrative strikes chord with investors
top_signals.summary: Zcash has reached a record high of $1,600, driven by investor interest in privacy-focused digital assets. The price surge coincides with the launch of a new European exchange-traded product (ETP).
top_signals.why_it_matters: Zcash's $1,600 record on the back of a European ETP launch shows privacy tokens can access institutional capital through regulated wrappers, though the narrow ETP-driven volume raises questions about sustained spot demand versus structured product flow.

top_signals.title: 'BTC still has room to catch up': Bitcoin's $80,000 breakout draws institutional demand as analysts weigh durability
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin has broken out above the $80,000 mark, driven largely by strong institutional demand through ETFs. While sentiment is improving, analysts are currently debating the long-term durability of this price rally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bitcoin's $80,000 breakout with ETF-driven institutional inflows tests whether this rally has repriced the asset for sticky allocation or merely reflects momentum-chasing that reverses on first macro wobble.

deals.summary: Connect Ventures has raised $55 million in the first close of its fifth fund. The fund is specifically targeting deeptech founders.

on_the_radar.title: Stablecoin cross-border flows surge 78%, defying crypto bear market
on_the_radar.summary: Cross-border stablecoin flows have surged by 77.5% to reach $220.3 billion in the year ending June. This growth occurred despite a broader 37% contraction in the overall crypto market.

on_the_radar.title: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
on_the_radar.summary: MoonPay is acquiring North Capital in an all-stock transaction valued at over $60 million. The deal aims to integrate regulated infrastructure for private and tokenized securities into MoonPay's offerings.

on_the_radar.title: Galaxy adds $100 million in Sky's sUSDS to treasury, buys SKY token
on_the_radar.summary: Galaxy Digital has allocated $100 million of its treasury to sUSDS, the staking version of Sky's stablecoin. Additionally, the firm has expanded its holdings by purchasing SKY tokens.

on_the_radar.title: CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocks45m, CFTC chair pushes tokenization as SEC opens door to onchain stocksMichael Selig said tokenization could reshape financial markets as the CFTC and SEC continue advancing onchain initiatives despite the CLARITY Act setback.
on_the_radar.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig advocates for tokenization to reshape financial markets as the SEC explores the possibility of on-chain stocks. This progress continues despite recent setbacks regarding the CLARITY Act.

on_the_radar.title: Raiffeisen to offer crypto trading across 11 European markets via Bitpanda
on_the_radar.summary: Raiffeisen Bank International is partnering with Bitpanda to provide crypto trading infrastructure across 11 European markets. This integration potentially opens digital asset access to approximately 18 million customers within the bank's network.

on_the_radar.title: BitMEX ends crypto trading, keeps withdrawals open after closure
on_the_radar.summary: BitMEX has officially ceased all crypto trading and deposits as part of its planned closure. The exchange continues to allow user withdrawals to ensure the return of assets.

on_the_radar.title: Canada's big six banks explore tokenized deposit system to modernize payments
on_the_radar.summary: Canada's six largest banks are exploring a tokenized deposit system aimed at modernizing the payments infrastructure. The initial phase of the project focuses on the efficient movement of tokenized deposits between different financial institutions.

on_the_radar.title: AI potential to drive crypto demand remains ‘underappreciated’: BlackRock
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock suggests that the potential for AI to drive cryptocurrency demand is currently underappreciated. The firm posits that autonomous AI agents will create structural demand for stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, and tokenized compute.

worth_a_read.title: Talus: Building Trustworthy AI Agents Onchain
worth_a_read.note: Talus's approach to verifiable AI agent execution on-chain is worth tracking as the sector moves from speculative agents to infrastructure that can actually be underwritten for trust assumptions.

worth_a_read.title: Nscale helped ByteDance subsidiary access Nvidia chips, swerving US rules
worth_a_read.note: Nscale's circumvention architecture for ByteDance's chip access reveals how compute scarcity is already fragmenting into jurisdictional arbitrage plays that will reshape cloud and mining infrastructure deployment.

worth_a_read.title: Exclusive: Connect Ventures raises $55m in first close of fifth fund to chase deeptech founders
worth_a_read.note: Connect Ventures's $55M first close for deeptech signals LP conviction is concentrating in funds with technical sourcing moats rather than generalist crypto exposure.

linkedin_post:
The SEC spent years building crypto enforcement cases it now admits it couldn't win in court. Commissioner Uyeda's candor this week—that early 2025 case drops were credibility protection, not policy pivot—means the discount investors applied for regulatory overhang was, in part, mispriced fear. That discount is now compressing.

Against that backdrop, the NYSE partnering with Blockchain.com to tokenize US stocks is not a pilot. It is incumbent infrastructure recognizing that on-chain settlement is becoming table stakes for retail access. The exchange is not displacing itself; it is capturing the channel before others do.

We are watching whether this confluence—regulatory retreat plus TradFi integration—creates a window where RWA infrastructure gets repriced on throughput and compliance tooling rather than token speculation. Hut 8's $140 million bid for Poolin's Texas data centers, at nearly 3x the opening offer, suggests some investors are already underwriting energy and compute assets on that forward basis.

The test: if tokenized equity volumes through the NYSE pipeline show institutional stickiness beyond launch-window marketing, the middleware layer—custody, oracle, compliance—becomes the position to build. If volumes flatten, this is another on-ramp that consumed capital without transforming it.

We are leaning toward the former, but not heavily. The credibility problem moved from the SEC to anyone making premature calls.
